changes_made.explanation: No changes needed - the extracted metadata accurately reflects the NLG aspects of the paper, which focuses on query generation using T5 for dense passage retrieval pre-training.

The paper does not evaluate generated queries using NLG-specific automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.). While it uses retrieval metrics (MRR, Recall, NDCG), these evaluate retrieval performance, not the quality of the generated queries themselves.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges to evaluate generated outputs. T5 is used for query generation, but not as an evaluator.
